title: Isolation, characterization and functionality exploration of Klebsiella pneumoniae specific bacteriophage isolated from hot and humid tropical region
description: The Klebsiella pneumoniae specific Bacteriophage was isolated from sewage water from Puducherry region. The Phage was named as RIVER_VPE_KPB25.
